notes.title: Viking Squad 1.016 World Events!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11794327/3b4d02b66aa8eab7ab091f76980dc5d0fdeab1a0.jpg[/img]

Hello fellow vikings, 

Today we have a fun update for the holidays! Along with some fixes, we are introducing a system called World Events. These add a little bit of variety in the way you choose to level up your characters! New players going through the game for the first time will have more options when going back to level up in previous levels. While veteran players will find a few new options when taking on hard mode.

We hope you enjoy the update!

[list]
[*]World Events have been added to the world map. These events place unique treasures or NPC's on levels you have beaten. Active events change every time you leave the village so choose wisely.
[*]Stat Gems have been added to the game. Stat gems are sold by a new black market NPC and increase a players stats by a small amount for each one collected. Players can also earn stat gems through other means, so stay on the lookout for them!
[*]Several holiday timed world events have been added to the game. Stay tuned for more info!
[*]Fixed some minor issues that could cause music to stop playing.
[*]Fixed some small collision issues in the catacombs.
[/list]

notes.title: Viking Squad update 1.015
notes.content:
Hello Vikings, we have a new update for you!

This patch fixes a network issue players have reported. It also comes with some balancing tweaks for various enemies and drops throughout the game. Read more about it below!

[list]
[*]Fix for network issue where in rare circumstances clients would not see each other
[*]Fix for crash when loading corrupted save games
[*]Tuned enemies and encounters throughout game based on user feedback
[*]Balancing and behavior tweaks to Loki boss fight
[*]Adjusted hit boxes on viking air-x attacks to be more forgiving
[*]Added hints to the squad defeated screen
[*]Various minor collision fixes to objects throughout the game
[/list]

notes.title: Viking Squad update 1.012
notes.content:
Hello fellow vikings, we have a new patch including several requested features and bug fixes!

In this update we've added an in game combo list, mouse support to menu screens and balanced a few things based on your feedback. Also stay tuned for some more exciting features in the next few weeks.

Thanks for playing and keep on pillaging!

[list]
[*]Added combo list to control menu
[*]Added Mouse support for menus
[*]Increased luck on goggles
[*]Tuned Yeti's multi punch attack so it's snapper and more consistent in its timing
[*]Fixed small area where players could fall and get stuck on goat island
[*]Better crash log reporting
[*]Fixed low chance crash in the hit detection system
[/list]

notes.title: Viking Squad update 1.001 live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, v1.001 is here!

This patch is to fix a few bugs people have been encountering since release. Mainly a save game issue some Russian players are seeing. There are also a few minor balancing tweaks to the shield and hammer Vikings from feedback.

Thanks for all your feedback!
[list]
[*]Fix for Cyrilic save file path strings
[*]Added ability to toggle controller vibration on/off in gameplay options menu
[*]Slight damage increase to Shield Viking attacks to bring him up to par with other Vikings on bosses
[*]Increased InAir-X damage on Hammer Viking
[*]Visual modification to boxers
[/list]
